meta.notes: A trial spawner configuration: the wave a trial spawner sends. spawn_potentials picks each mob by weight, here mostly husks and now and then a baby zombie (IsBaby: 1, written as vanilla's own files do). total_mobs and simultaneous_mobs grow with each extra player. When the wave is beaten the spawner ejects one of loot_tables_to_eject. A trial spawner block uses it when its normal_config names msm_examples:desert_wave, for example /setblock ~ ~ ~ minecraft:trial_spawner{normal_config:"msm_examples:desert_wave"}.
